continuity_scope: World of Warcraft: Shadowlands, Patch 9.0 launch baseline (North American English; 23 November 2020, Americas). This is deliberately non-overlapping with SRC-135's World of Warcraft: Dragonflight Patch 10.0 Dragon Aspect cohort: it instead captures Shadowlands launch's afterlife/Revendreth witness and makes no duplicate character claims.
work_or_witnesses: Blizzard: Shadowlands Content Update Notes (23 November 2020)
Blizzard: Shadowlands Arrives November 23 (global release schedule)
Blizzard: Shadowlands Preview: Revendreth and the Venthyr Covenant
coverage_rule: All named individual figures with dedicated official paragraphs in the selected Revendreth launch-content preview, plus Sylvanas Windrunner as the single named actor in the Patch 9.0 launch premise: Sire Denathrius, Prince Renathal, General Draven, and Sylvanas Windrunner. This offers a distinct, evidence-backed comparison of Shadowlands political/afterlife roles not present in SRC-135.
omissions: Every SRC-135 Dragonflight character and any Dragonflight claim; no duplicate character record is created.
Player-created adventurers, heroes, Maw Walkers, and player-selected class/race/faction/covenant identities.

Other named figures in the product/preview, including the Arbiter, the Jailer, and unnamed or collectively named inhabitants, because they lack a selected dedicated paragraph under this narrow witness rule.
All post-9.0 Shadowlands content updates, raids, later stories, WoW Classic variants, other expansions, Warcraft strategy-game campaigns, Chronicle volumes, novels, comics, and adaptations.
Covenants, Venthyr, Stoneborn, zones, anima, dungeons, raids, gear, and systems as character nodes.
uncertainties: World of Warcraft is live service; this pass fixes the 9.0 launch state, while the selected preview is pre-launch marketing for launch content. Later Shadowlands patches and retrospective lore are excluded.

The official preview presents Sire Denathrius's self-description and Prince Renathal's suspicion. It is publisher narration of a situation with in-world political claims; the records retain the source's qualifiers where they matter and do not adjudicate hidden motives beyond the stated text.
The Warcraft franchise has Chronicle, game-text, novel, comic, adaptation, and future-retcon layers. This pass does not claim to settle their hierarchy or continuity conflicts.
Names and terms follow the North American English localization; localization variants are not merged without an exact official witness.
evidence_basis: First-party Blizzard World of Warcraft launch notes, official global schedule, and official Revendreth preview. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, community guide, or player forum material is used as evidence.
